title: Settings
subtitle: Company details, privacy and your personal preferences.

org.title: Your organisation
org.readonly_hint: Only the administrator can edit company details.
org.modal_hint: These details appear on printed QR codes, unit labels, and other reporter-facing materials.
org.card_hint: These details appear on printed QR codes and unit labels.
org.logo_hint: This logo is shown on the portal, QR codes, and elsewhere. (PNG/JPG, max. 2 MB).
org.portal_background_hint: Background image for the report portal after scanning a QR code (PNG/JPG, max. 2 MB, minimum 1080 px wide recommended).

qr_stickers.title: QR print sheet
qr_stickers.hint: Branding for Avery 62×89-R stickers and A6/A5/A4 print sheets (download per location).

avery_62x89_r.title: Avery 62×89-R
avery_62x89_r.hint: 9 labels per sheet (62 × 89 mm) — Avery L7108REV.
avery_62x89_r.header_label: Text block at the top of the sticker
avery_62x89_r.header_placeholder: e.g. Scan here to report an issue
avery_62x89_r.header_hint: Max. 120 characters. Empty = location · unit on the sticker.
avery_62x89_r.tenant_logo_label: Organization logo position on the sticker
avery_62x89_r.background_hint: Choose your own background image (PNG/JPG, max. 4 MB).
avery_62x89_r.background_remove_confirm: Remove custom background and revert to the default design?
avery_62x89_r.save_hint: The QR code stays fixed in the centre.

printable_page.title: Print sheet A6 / A5 / A4
printable_page.hint: One background for all paper sizes (1 QR per page).
printable_page.tenant_logo_label: Organization logo position on the print sheet
printable_page.tenant_address_label: Address position on the print sheet
printable_page.preset_hint: Applies to A6, A5 and A4. A custom upload overrides the preset.
printable_page.background_remove_confirm: Remove the custom background and fall back to the selected preset?
printable_page.save_hint: Save the preset. Uploads apply as soon as you choose a file.
printable_page.preview_alt: Preview of the QR print sheet background

notifications.title: Email notifications
notifications.hint: Personal preferences for emails from WinProx.
notifications.new_qr_issue_label: Receive an email for every new report
notifications.new_qr_issue_hint: Only for reports submitted via the QR portal.

work_menu.title: Work menu settings
work_menu.hint: Choose which Work menu items are visible in backoffice. Disabled items disappear from the sidebar; existing unit and category settings on the QR portal keep working.
work_menu.calendar_hint: Calendar view for tasks, issues and reservations.
work_menu.reservations_hint: Reservation management in backoffice. QR booking on units that already had it stays available.
work_menu.inspection_rounds_hint: List and planning of inspection rounds. Unit checks remain available separately.
work_menu.unit_measurements_hint: Measure fields and history in backoffice. QR measurements on units that already had them stay available.

errors.reservations_disabled: Reservations are disabled in the work menu. You cannot newly enable this on units or categories.
errors.unit_measurements_disabled: Unit measurements are disabled in the work menu. You cannot newly enable this on units or categories.

privacy.title: Privacy & data export
privacy.hint: Only the administrator can download a machine-readable overview (JSON in a ZIP file) of the account and relevant activity within your tenant. The file may contain sensitive data — store it securely.

style.title: Customise WinProx style
style.hint: Choose how WinProx looks for you. Your choice applies on every device where you are signed in.

simple.label: Standard
simple.description: Clear and calm — the default WinProx look.

dark.label: Dark
dark.description: Night mode with dark backgrounds, like on your phone.
